purpose: Teach: ヒューマン/ギア/タブー/シアトル/ロサンゼルス/スターリン/麻雀/アクティブ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいお店、ヒューマンなあたたかみがあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your new place has such a genuine warmth to it.
lines.style: Gentle observation, soft and appreciative. Slow pace. Warm tone, eyes lingering. Not quite a question, more a gift of noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、自転車のギアを変えたら走りやすくなったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, adjusting the bike's gears made such a difference — it rides so much easier now.
lines.style: Bright, energetic opening. Quick pace, conversational rhythm. Small pride in the discovery. Sharing something that worked out right.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、芸能界のタブーって、いろいろあるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, there's a lot of unspoken rules in that world, aren't there.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Conversational, as if thinking aloud alongside someone. Gentle trailing at the end—not accusatory, just wondering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、シアトルのコーヒー文化、勉強したいな、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd really love to study coffee culture in Seattle sometime — there's so much to learn there.
lines.style: Eager but sincere, not scattered. Building momentum through the sentence. Eyes bright with genuine curiosity. Lean forward slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ロサンゼルスにカフェ旅行行きたいよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: A cafe trip to LA sounds perfect, doesn't it? I've been thinking about that.
lines.style: Warmly earnest, invitation in the tone. Steady pace. Soft emphasis on the shared dream. Reaching toward the idea together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、スターリン時代の歴史本、お客様が読んでたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Someone was reading this fascinating history book about the Stalin era the other day.
lines.style: Observant, sharing a small detail. Neutral, curious tone—noticing what customers bring in. Slight brightness at the unusual subject matter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が麻雀の話で盛り上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers were really into a mahjong conversation earlier — it was lively.
lines.style: Warm recollection, animated. Smiling through the words. Quick energy. The pleasure of seeing people engaged and happy in your space.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の運営、アクティブにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's keep the shop running with energy and intention, yeah?
lines.style: Forward-looking, gently encouraging. Firm but not bossy. Building toward something together. Close with quiet resolve and partnership.
